```typescript:frontend/types/gridItems.ts
  const baseCategory = toSingular(category)
  
  // Handle section-specific naming
  switch (section.toLowerCase()) {
    // Discover sections
    case 'spotlight':
    case 'trending':
      return `${baseCategory} ${section} ${type} ${index + 1}`
    
    // Brand sections
    case 'alphabetical':
    case 'newest':
    case 'featured':
    case 'popular':
      return `${baseCategory} ${type} ${index + 1}`
    
    // Designer sections
    case 'lookbooks':
      switch (type) {
        case 'designer': return `Designer Lookbook ${index + 1}`
        case 'brand': return `Brand Lookbook ${index + 1}`
        case 'product': return `Collection Lookbook ${index + 1}`
      }
    
    // Location sections
    case 'location':
    case 'locations':
      return `${type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1)} ${index + 1} from Location`
    
    // Rankings sections
    case 'top-rated':
    case 'recently-liked':
    case 'most-liked':
    case 'leaderboard':
      return `${baseCategory} ${section.split('-').map(word => 
        word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)).join(' ')} ${type} ${index + 1}`
    
    // Categories sections (products)
    case 'tops':
    case 'bottoms':
    case 'outerwear':
    case 'accessories':
    case 'footwear':
      return `${baseCategory} ${toSingular(section)} ${index + 1}`
    
    default:
      return `${baseCategory} ${type} ${index + 1}`
  }

  const sectionLabel = section.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + section.slice(1)
  
  switch (type) {
    case 'designer':
      if (section.toLowerCase() === 'lookbooks') return 'Designer Collection'
      return `${sectionLabel}: Designer`
      
    case 'brand':
      if (section.toLowerCase() === 'lookbooks') return `${brandType} Collection`
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandType} Brand`
      
    case 'product':
      if (section.toLowerCase() === 'lookbooks') return `${brandName} Collection`
      if (['tops', 'bottoms', 'outerwear', 'accessories', 'footwear'].includes(section.toLowerCase())) {
        return `${brandName} ${toSingular(section)}`
      }
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandName} ${toSingular(productType || '')}`
      
    default:
      return sectionLabel
  }
}
```

```typescript:frontend/app/brand/[id]/page.tsx
                  alt={`Brand ${id}`}
                  fill
                  className="object-contain"
                  priority
                />
              </div>
              
              <div className="h-20 grid grid-cols-4 border-t border-black mt-4 -mr-8">

                  <button

            </div>

          {/* Vertical Divider */}
          <div className="hidden md:block w-px bg-black" />

          {/* Brand Info Section */}
          <div className={`${isMobile ? 'w-full pb-32 border-t border-black' : 'w-[60%]'}`}>

              <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-6">
```

```typescript:frontend/types/gridItems.ts
export const getFormattedLabel = (
  type: string,
  section: string,
  brandType: string,
  productType?: string,
  brandName?: string
) => {
  const capitalizedSection = section.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + section.slice(1)
  
  switch (type) {
    case 'designer':
      return `${capitalizedSection}: ${brandType} Designer`
    case 'brand':
      return `${capitalizedSection}: ${brandType} Brand`
    case 'product':
      return `${capitalizedSection}: ${brandName} ${toSingular(productType || '')}`
    default:
      return ''
  }
}
```

2. Popular sections
3. Spotlight sections
4. Trending sections
5. All other layer 2 page sections

The issue is that the capitalization needs to be handled in both getFormattedLabel and directly in getRegularItems. Here's the correct fix:

```typescript:frontend/types/gridItems.ts
export const getFormattedLabel = (
  type: string, 
  section: string, 
  brandType?: BrandType, 
  productType?: ProductCategory, 
  brandName?: string,
  location?: Location
) => {
  // Capitalize first letter of section
  const sectionLabel = section.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + section.slice(1).toLowerCase()
  
  // Handle location-based sections
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'location' || section.toLowerCase() === 'locations') {
    switch (type) {
      case 'designer':
        return `${location?.name}: ${brandType} Designer`
      case 'brand':
        return `${location?.name}: ${brandType} Brand`
      case 'product':
        return `${location?.name}: ${brandName} ${toSingular(productType || '')}`
    }
  }

  // Special case for lookbooks section
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'lookbooks') {
    switch (type) {
      case 'designer':
        return `${brandType} Designer Collection`
      case 'brand':
        return `${brandType} Collection`
      case 'product':
        return `${brandName} Collection`
    }
  }

  // Regular section labeling
  switch (type) {
    case 'designer':
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandType} Designer`
    case 'brand':
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandType} Brand`
    case 'product':
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandName} ${toSingular(productType || '')}`
    default:
      return sectionLabel
  }
}
```

I recommend creating a simple placeholder system with this structure:

```typescript:frontend/types/placeholders.ts
export const placeholderImages = {
  product: {
    default: '/placeholders/product-default.jpg',
    variants: [
      '/placeholders/product-1.jpg',
      '/placeholders/product-2.jpg',
      '/placeholders/product-3.jpg',
      '/placeholders/product-4.jpg'
    ]
  },
  brand: {
    default: '/placeholders/brand-default.jpg',
    variants: [
      '/placeholders/brand-1.jpg',
      '/placeholders/brand-2.jpg',
      '/placeholders/brand-3.jpg',
      '/placeholders/brand-4.jpg'
    ],
    logo: '/placeholders/brand-logo.png'
  },
  designer: {
    default: '/placeholders/designer-default.jpg',
    variants: [
      '/placeholders/designer-1.jpg',
      '/placeholders/designer-2.jpg',
      '/placeholders/designer-3.jpg',
      '/placeholders/designer-4.jpg'
    ]
  }
} as const

export const getPlaceholderImage = (
  type: 'product' | 'brand' | 'designer',
  index?: number
) => {
  if (typeof index === 'number') {
    const variants = placeholderImages[type].variants
    return variants[index % variants.length]
  }
  return placeholderImages[type].default
}
```

Then use it in your components like:

```typescript
import { getPlaceholderImage } from '@/types/placeholders'

// In your component
const images = [
  getPlaceholderImage('product', 0),
  getPlaceholderImage('product', 1),
  getPlaceholderImage('product', 2),
  getPlaceholderImage('product', 3),
]
```

Benefits of this approach:
1. Keeps existing code structure intact
2. Easy to transition to real data later
3. Centralized placeholder management
4. Type-safe
5. Consistent across the platform
6. No logic changes needed in components

File structure:
```
frontend/
  public/
    placeholders/
      product-default.jpg
      product-1.jpg
      product-2.jpg
      ...
      brand-default.jpg
      brand-1.jpg
      ...
      designer-default.jpg
      designer-1.jpg
      ...
```

When you're ready to transition to real data, you'll only need to:
1. Update the image sources in your data fetching layer
2. Remove the placeholders.ts file
3. No component logic changes needed

```typescript:frontend/app/[category]/[section]/[subsection]/page.tsx
      designer: type === 'product' ? `Designer ${i + 1}` : undefined,
```

2. Then update getRegularItems:

```typescript:frontend/app/[category]/[section]/[subsection]/page.tsx
const getRegularItems = () => {
  const type = getItemType()
  
  return Array(20).fill(null).map((_, i) => {
    const brandType = brandTypes[i % brandTypes.length]
    const brandName = `Brand${i + 1}`
    const subsectionLabel = subsection.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + subsection.slice(1).toLowerCase()

    // Handle brand sections
    if (type === 'brand') {
      return {
        id: `item-${i}`,
        type,
        name: getFormattedName(type, category, subsection, i),
        image: getPlaceholderImage('brand', i % 4),
        category: `${toSingular(category)} / ${subsection}`,
        label: `${subsectionLabel}: ${brandType} Brand`
      }
    }

    // Handle designer sections
    if (type === 'designer') {
      return {
        id: `item-${i}`,
        type,
        name: getFormattedName(type, category, subsection, i),
        image: getPlaceholderImage('designer', i % 4),
        category: `${toSingular(category)} / ${subsection}`,
        label: `${subsectionLabel}: ${brandType} Designer`
      }
    }

    // Handle product sections
    return {
      id: `item-${i}`,
      name: `${toSingular(category)} ${subsection} ${i + 1}`,
      type,
      category: subsection,
      image: getPlaceholderImage('product', i % 4),
      brand: brandName,
      designer: `Designer ${i + 1}`,
      label: `${brandName} ${toSingular(subsection)}`
    }
  })
}
```


```typescript
const toSingular = (word: string) => {
  switch (word.toLowerCase()) {
    case 'accessories': return 'Accessory'
    case 'tops': return 'Top'
    case 'bottoms': return 'Bottom'
    case 'outerwear': return 'Outerwear'
    case 'hoodies & sweaters': return 'Hoodie & Sweater'
    default: return word
  }
}
```

```typescript:frontend/types/gridItems.ts
export const getFormattedName = (
  type: string, 
  category: string, 
  section: string, 
  index: number,
  location?: Location
) => {
  const baseCategory = toSingular(category)
  
  // Handle discover sections
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'discover') {
    switch (type) {
      case 'designer':
        return `${baseCategory} Designer ${index + 1}`
      case 'brand':
        return `${baseCategory} Brand ${index + 1}`
      case 'product':
        return `${baseCategory} Product ${index + 1}`
    }
  }

  // Handle location-based sections
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'location' || section.toLowerCase() === 'locations') {
    return `${type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1)} ${index + 1} from ${location?.name || 'Location'}`
  }

  // Handle lookbooks
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'lookbooks') {
    switch (type) {
      case 'brand':
        return `Brand Lookbook ${index + 1}`
      default:
        return `${type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1)} ${index + 1}`
    }
  }

  // Default naming
  return `${type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1)} ${index + 1}`
}

export const getFormattedLabel = (
  type: string, 
  section: string, 
  brandType?: BrandType, 
  productType?: ProductCategory, 
  brandName?: string,
  location?: Location
) => {
  const sectionLabel = section.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + section.slice(1).toLowerCase()
  
  // Handle location-based sections
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'location' || section.toLowerCase() === 'locations') {
    switch (type) {
      case 'designer':
        return `${location?.name}: ${brandType} Designer`
      case 'brand':
        return `${location?.name}: ${brandType} Brand`
      case 'product':
        return `${location?.name}: ${brandName} ${toSingular(productType || '')}`
    }
  }

  // Special case for lookbooks section
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'lookbooks') {
    switch (type) {
      case 'brand':
        return `${brandType} Collection`
      default:
        return `${brandName} Collection`
    }
  }

  // Regular section labeling
  switch (type) {
    case 'designer':
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandType} Designer`
    case 'brand':
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandType} Brand`
    case 'product':
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandName} ${toSingular(productType || '')}`
    default:
      return sectionLabel
  }
}
```

```typescript:frontend/types/gridItems.ts
export const getFormattedName = (

  // Handle discover sections
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'discover') {

      case 'brand':
        return `${baseCategory} Brand ${index + 1}`

        return `${baseCategory} Product ${index + 1}`
    }
  }

  // Handle location-based sections

  }

  return `${type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + type.slice(1)} ${index + 1}`
}

export const toSingular = (word: string) => {
  switch (word.toLowerCase()) {
    case 'accessories': return 'Accessory'
    case 'tops': return 'Top'
    case 'bottoms': return 'Bottom'
    case 'outerwear': return 'Outerwear'
    case 'hoodies & sweaters': return 'Hoodie & Sweater'
    case 'gifts': return 'Gift'
    default: return word
  }
}

export const getFormattedLabel = (
  type: string, 
  section: string, 
  brandType?: BrandType, 
  productType?: ProductCategory, 
  brandName?: string,
  location?: Location
) => {

  // Handle location-based sections
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'location' || section.toLowerCase() === 'locations') {
    switch (type) {
      case 'designer':
        return `${location?.name}: ${brandType} Designer`
      case 'brand':
        return `${location?.name}: ${brandType} Brand`
      case 'product':
        return `${location?.name}: ${brandName} ${toSingular(productType || '')}`
    }
  }

  // Special case for lookbooks section (brands only)
  if (section.toLowerCase() === 'lookbooks') {
    if (type === 'brand') {
      return `${brandType} Brand Lookbook`
    }
    return `${brandName} Collection`
  }

  // Regular section labeling
  switch (type) {
    case 'designer':
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandType} Designer`
    case 'brand':
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandType} Brand`
    case 'product':
      return `${sectionLabel}: ${brandName} ${toSingular(productType || '')}`
    default:
      return sectionLabel
  }
}
```

```typescript:frontend/types/placeholders.ts
export const getPlaceholderImage = (type: string, index: number = 0, category?: string, subcategory?: string) => {
  // Handle specific product categories
  if (type === 'product' && category && subcategory) {
    const gender = category.toLowerCase()
    const section = subcategory.toLowerCase()

    if (section === 'collections' && (gender === 'mens' || gender === 'womens')) {

    // Handle gifts

      return placeholderImages.product.gifts[index % 4]
    }
    
    // Handle lookbooks
    if (section === 'lookbooks') {
      return placeholderImages.product.lookbooks[index % 4]
    }
  }

  // Handle brand and designer types
  switch (type) {
    case 'brand':
      return placeholderImages.brand.variants[index % 4] || placeholderImages.brand.default
    case 'designer':
      return placeholderImages.designer.variants[index % 4] || placeholderImages.designer.default
    default:
      return placeholderImages.product.default
  }
}
```

```typescript:frontend/types/placeholders.ts
export const getPlaceholderImage = (type: string, index: number = 0, category?: string, subcategory?: string) => {
  // Handle brand and designer types first
  if (type === 'brand') {
    return placeholderImages.brand.variants[index % 4] || placeholderImages.brand.default
  }
  
  if (type === 'designer') {
    return placeholderImages.designer.variants[index % 4] || placeholderImages.designer.default
  }

  // Handle products
  if (type === 'product') {
    // If no category/subcategory, return default
    if (!category || !subcategory) {
      return placeholderImages.product.default
    }

    const gender = category.toLowerCase()
    const section = subcategory.toLowerCase()

    // Handle mens products
    if (gender === 'mens') {
      if (section === 'sweaters') {
        return placeholderImages.product.mens.sweaters[index % 4]
      }
      if (section === 'collections') {
        return placeholderImages.product.mens.collections[index % 4]
      }
    }

    // Handle womens products
    if (gender === 'womens') {
      if (section === 'hoodies') {
        return placeholderImages.product.womens.hoodies[index % 4]
      }
      if (section === 'collections') {
        return placeholderImages.product.womens.collections[index % 4]
      }
    }

    // Handle generic categories
    if (section === 'gifts') {
      return placeholderImages.product.gifts[index % 4]
    }
    if (section === 'lookbooks') {
      return placeholderImages.product.lookbooks[index % 4]
    }

    // Fallback to default if no match
    return placeholderImages.product.default
  }

  return placeholderImages.product.default
}
```

```typescript:frontend/types/placeholders.ts
export const getPlaceholderImage = (type: string, index: number = 0, category?: string, subcategory?: string) => {
  // Handle brand and designer types first
  if (type === 'brand') {
    return placeholderImages.brand.variants[index % 4] || placeholderImages.brand.default
  }
  
  if (type === 'designer') {
    return placeholderImages.designer.variants[index % 4] || placeholderImages.designer.default
  }

  // Handle products
  if (type === 'product') {
    // If no category/subcategory, return default
    if (!category || !subcategory) {
      return placeholderImages.product.default
    }

    const gender = category.toLowerCase()
    const section = subcategory.toLowerCase()

    // Get the appropriate category object
    const genderSection = placeholderImages.product[gender as 'mens' | 'womens']
    if (!genderSection) return placeholderImages.product.default

    // Handle specific sections
    switch (section) {
      case 'tops':
        return genderSection.tops.thumbnails[index % genderSection.tops.thumbnails.length] || genderSection.tops.default
      case 'bottoms':
        return genderSection.bottoms.thumbnails[index % genderSection.bottoms.thumbnails.length] || genderSection.bottoms.default
      case 'outerwear':
        return genderSection.outerwear.thumbnails[index % genderSection.outerwear.thumbnails.length] || genderSection.outerwear.default
      case 'sweaters':
        return genderSection.sweaters?.thumbnails[index % genderSection.sweaters.thumbnails.length] || genderSection.sweaters?.default
      case 'hoodies':
        return genderSection.hoodies?.thumbnails[index % genderSection.hoodies.thumbnails.length] || genderSection.hoodies?.default
      case 'accessories':
        return genderSection.accessories.thumbnails[index % genderSection.accessories.thumbnails.length] || genderSection.accessories.default
      case 'footwear':
        return genderSection.footwear.thumbnails[index % genderSection.footwear.thumbnails.length] || genderSection.footwear.default
      case 'gifts':
```

```typescript:frontend/types/placeholders.ts
export const getPlaceholderImage = (type: string, index: number = 0, category?: string, subcategory?: string) => {
  // Handle brand and designer types
  if (type === 'brand' || type === 'designer') {
    const imageSet = placeholderImages[type]
    return imageSet.variants[index % imageSet.variants.length] || imageSet.default
  }

  // Handle products with proper category mapping
  if (type === 'product') {
    if (!category || !subcategory) {
      return placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
    }

    const gender = category.toLowerCase()
    const section = subcategory.toLowerCase()

    // Normalize section names for consistency with future dynamic data
    const sectionMap: Record<string, string> = {
      'tops': 'tops',
      'bottoms': 'bottoms',
      'outerwear': 'outerwear',
      'sweaters': 'sweaters',
      'hoodies & sweaters': 'hoodies',
      'accessories': 'accessories',
      'footwear': 'footwear',
      'gifts': 'gifts',
      'lookbooks': 'lookbooks'
    }

    const normalizedSection = sectionMap[section]
    if (!normalizedSection) {
      console.warn(`Unknown section: ${section}`)
      return placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
    }

    // Special sections
    if (['gifts', 'lookbooks'].includes(normalizedSection)) {
      const specialSection = placeholderImages.product[normalizedSection as 'gifts' | 'lookbooks']
      return specialSection.thumbnails[index % specialSection.thumbnails.length]
    }

    // Gender-specific sections
    const genderSection = placeholderImages.product[gender as 'mens' | 'womens']
    if (!genderSection) {
      console.warn(`Unknown gender: ${gender}`)
      return placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
    }

    const productSection = genderSection[normalizedSection as keyof typeof genderSection]
    if (!productSection) {
      console.warn(`Unknown product section: ${normalizedSection} for ${gender}`)
      return placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
    }

    return productSection.thumbnails[index % productSection.thumbnails.length]
  }

  return placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
}
```

'use client'
import { Fragment, useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { Menu, Transition } from '@headlessui/react'
import Link from 'next/link'

interface MegaMenuProps {
  category: string
}

const topLinks = ['Discover', 'Brands', 'Categories', 'Designers', 'Rankings']
const bottomLinks = ['Login', 'Liked', 'Saved', 'Submissions', 'About']
const discoverLinks = ['View All', 'Spotlight', 'Trending', 'Location', 'Random']
const brandLinks = ['View All', 'Alphabetical', 'Newest', 'Featured', 'Popular', 'Lookbooks', 'Random']
const categoryLinks = ['View All', 'Tops', 'Bottoms', 'Outerwear', 'Hoodies & Sweaters', 'Accessories', 'Footwear']
const designerLinks = ['View All', 'Trending', 'Spotlight', 'Locations', 'Random']
const rankingLinks = ['View All', 'Top Rated', 'Recently Liked', 'Most Liked', 'Leaderboard', 'Locations']

const MegaMenu = ({ category }: MegaMenuProps) => {
  const [showDiscoverMenu, setShowDiscoverMenu] = useState(false)
  const [showBrandsMenu, setShowBrandsMenu] = useState(false)
  const [showCategoriesMenu, setShowCategoriesMenu] = useState(false)
  const [showDesignersMenu, setShowDesignersMenu] = useState(false)
  const [showRankingsMenu, setShowRankingsMenu] = useState(false)
  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false)

  const handleLinkClick = (link: string) => {
    // Close all other menus first
    const closeAllExcept = (menuName: string) => {
      if (menuName !== 'Discover') setShowDiscoverMenu(false)
      if (menuName !== 'Brands') setShowBrandsMenu(false)
      if (menuName !== 'Categories') setShowCategoriesMenu(false)
      if (menuName !== 'Designers') setShowDesignersMenu(false)
      if (menuName !== 'Rankings') setShowRankingsMenu(false)
    }

    // Toggle the clicked menu and close others
    if (link === 'Discover') {
      closeAllExcept('Discover')
      setShowDiscoverMenu(!showDiscoverMenu)
    }
    if (link === 'Brands') {
      closeAllExcept('Brands')
      setShowBrandsMenu(!showBrandsMenu)
    }
    if (link === 'Categories') {
      closeAllExcept('Categories')
      setShowCategoriesMenu(!showCategoriesMenu)
    }
    if (link === 'Designers') {
      closeAllExcept('Designers')
      setShowDesignersMenu(!showDesignersMenu)
    }
    if (link === 'Rankings') {
      closeAllExcept('Rankings')
      setShowRankingsMenu(!showRankingsMenu)
    }
  }

  const getBrandsHref = (link: string) => {
    const formattedLink = link.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')
    if (formattedLink === 'view-all') {
      return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/brands/view-all`
    }
    return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/brands/${formattedLink}`
  }

  const getDiscoverHref = (link: string) => {
    const formattedLink = link.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')
    if (formattedLink === 'view-all') {
      return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/discover/view-all`
    }
    return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/discover/${formattedLink}`
  }

  const getCategoriesHref = (link: string) => {
    const formattedLink = link.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')
    if (formattedLink === 'view-all') {
      return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/categories/view-all`
    }
    return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/categories/${formattedLink}`
  }

  const getDesignersHref = (link: string) => {
    const formattedLink = link.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')
    if (formattedLink === 'view-all') {
      return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/designers/view-all`
    }
    return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/designers/${formattedLink}`
  }

  const getRankingsHref = (link: string) => {
    const formattedLink = link.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')
    if (formattedLink === 'view-all') {
      return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/rankings/view-all`
    }
    return `/${category.toLowerCase()}/rankings/${formattedLink}`
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = event.target as HTMLElement
      if (!target.closest('.menu-container')) {
        setShowDiscoverMenu(false)
        setShowBrandsMenu(false)
        setShowCategoriesMenu(false)
        setShowDesignersMenu(false)
        setShowRankingsMenu(false)
        setIsMenuOpen(false)
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMenuOpen) {
      setShowDiscoverMenu(false)
      setShowBrandsMenu(false)
      setShowCategoriesMenu(false)
      setShowDesignersMenu(false)
      setShowRankingsMenu(false)
    }
  }, [isMenuOpen])

  return (
    <Menu as="div" className="relative">
      {({ open }) => {
        if (open !== isMenuOpen) setIsMenuOpen(open)
        return (
          <>
            <Menu.Button className="text-sm tracking-[0.25em] hover:text-gray-500 transition-colors">
              {category}
            </Menu.Button>

            <div className="menu-container">
              <Transition
                show={isMenuOpen}
                as={Fragment}
                enter="transition duration-100 ease-out"
                enterFrom="transform translate-x-[-100%]"
                enterTo="transform translate-x-0"
                leave="transition duration-75 ease-out"
                leaveFrom="transform translate-x-0"
                leaveTo="transform translate-x-[-100%]"
              >
                <Menu.Items static className="fixed left-0 top-[104px] bottom-0 w-[400px] bg-white z-[48] overflow-y-auto">
                  {/* White overlay to hide the border lines */}
                  <div className="absolute -top-[1px] left-0 right-0 h-[2px] bg-white z-[1004]" />
                  
                  <div className="relative h-full border-r border-black">
                    {/* Content wrapper */}
                    <div className="min-h-full flex flex-col justify-between">
                      {/* Top Links */}
                      <div className="py-6">
                        {topLinks.map((link) => (
                          <Menu.Item key={link}>
                            {({ active }) => (
                              <a
                                href="#"
                                className="block px-12 py-4 text-sm tracking-[0.25em] hover:text-gray-500 transition-colors"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.preventDefault()
                                  handleLinkClick(link)
                                }}
                              >
                                {link}
                              </a>
                            )}
                          </Menu.Item>
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      {/* Bottom Links */}
                      <div className="py-8">
                        {bottomLinks.map((link) => (
                          <Menu.Item key={link}>
                            {({ active }) => (
                              <Link
                                href={`/${link.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')}`}
                                className="block px-12 py-2 text-xs font-light tracking-[0.25em] hover:text-gray-500 transition-colors"
                                onClick={() => setIsMenuOpen(false)}
                              >
                                {link}
                              </Link>
                            )}
                          </Menu.Item>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Menu.Items>
              </Transition>

              {/* Layer 2 - Discover Menu */}
              <Transition
                show={showDiscoverMenu}
                as={Fragment}
                enter="transition duration-100 ease-out"
                enterFrom="transform translate-x-[-100%]"
                enterTo="transform translate-x-0"
                leave="transition duration-75 ease-out"
                leaveFrom="transform translate-x-0"
                leaveTo="transform translate-x-[-100%]"
              >
                <div className="fixed left-[400px] top-[104px] bottom-0 w-[400px] bg-white z-[47] border-r border-black overflow-y-auto">
                  <div className="py-6">
                    {discoverLinks.map((link) => (
                      <Link
                        key={link}
                        href={getDiscoverHref(link)}
                        className="block px-12 py-4 text-sm tracking-[0.25em] hover:text-gray-500 transition-colors"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setShowDiscoverMenu(false)
                          setIsMenuOpen(false)
                        }}
                      >
                        {link}
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Transition>

              {/* Layer 2 - Brands Menu */}
              <Transition
                show={showBrandsMenu}
                as={Fragment}
                enter="transition duration-100 ease-out"
                enterFrom="transform translate-x-[-100%]"
                enterTo="transform translate-x-0"
                leave="transition duration-75 ease-out"
                leaveFrom="transform translate-x-0"
                leaveTo="transform translate-x-[-100%]"
              >
                <div className="fixed left-[400px] top-[104px] bottom-0 w-[400px] bg-white z-[47] border-r border-black overflow-y-auto">
                  <div className="py-6">
                    {brandLinks.map((link) => (
                      <Link
                        key={link}
                        href={getBrandsHref(link)}
                        className="block px-12 py-4 text-sm tracking-[0.25em] hover:text-gray-500 transition-colors"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setShowBrandsMenu(false)
                          setIsMenuOpen(false)
                        }}
                      >
                        {link}
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Transition>

              {/* Layer 2 - Categories Menu */}
              <Transition
                show={showCategoriesMenu}
                as={Fragment}
                enter="transition duration-100 ease-out"
                enterFrom="transform translate-x-[-100%]"
                enterTo="transform translate-x-0"
                leave="transition duration-75 ease-out"
                leaveFrom="transform translate-x-0"
                leaveTo="transform translate-x-[-100%]"
              >
                <div className="fixed left-[400px] top-[104px] bottom-0 w-[400px] bg-white z-[47] border-r border-black overflow-y-auto">
                  <div className="py-6">
                    {categoryLinks.map((link) => (
                      <Link
                        key={link}
                        href={getCategoriesHref(link)}
                        className="block px-12 py-4 text-sm tracking-[0.25em] hover:text-gray-500 transition-colors"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setShowCategoriesMenu(false)
                          setIsMenuOpen(false)
                        }}
                      >
                        {link}
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </Transition>

              {/* Layer 2 - Designers Menu */}
              <Transition
                show={showDesignersMenu}
                as={Fragment}
                enter="transition duration-100 ease-out"
                enterFrom="transform translate-x-[-100%]"
                enterTo="transform translate-x-0"

              >
                <div className="fixed left-[400px] top-[104px] bottom-0 w-[400px] bg-white z-[47] border-r border-black overflow-y-auto">

                        {link}

```21:122:frontend/components/layout/MobileMenu.tsx
export default function MobileMenu({ isOpen, onClose, items }: MobileMenuProps) {
  const [activeLayer0, setActiveLayer0] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [activeLayer1, setActiveLayer1] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const router = useRouter()

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      setActiveLayer0(null)
      setActiveLayer1(null)
    }
  }, [isOpen])

  const getLayer2Links = (category: string) => {
    switch (category) {
      case 'Discover': return discoverLinks
      case 'Brands': return brandLinks
      case 'Categories': return categoryLinks
      case 'Designers': return designerLinks
      case 'Rankings': return rankingLinks
      default: return []
    }
  }

  const handleBack = () => {
    if (activeLayer1) {
      setActiveLayer1(null)
    } else if (activeLayer0) {
      setActiveLayer0(null)
    }
  }

  const handleHeaderAction = () => {
    if (activeLayer1 || activeLayer0) {
      handleBack()
    } else {
      onClose()
    }
  }

  const handleLayer2Click = (link: string) => {
    if (!activeLayer0 || !activeLayer1) return
    
    const formattedLink = link.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')
    const path = `/${activeLayer0.toLowerCase()}/${activeLayer1.toLowerCase()}/${formattedLink}`
    router.push(path)
    setActiveLayer0(null)
    setActiveLayer1(null)
    onClose()
  }

  const handleBottomLinkClick = (link: string) => {
    const path = `/${link.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')}`
    router.push(path)
    onClose()
  }

  return (
    <div 
      className={`fixed inset-0 bg-white z-[9999] transform transition-transform duration-300 overflow-hidden ${
        isOpen ? 'translate-y-0' : '-translate-y-full'

          {activeLayer0 || activeLayer1 ? (
            <>
              <ArrowLeft className="w-[18px] h-[18px] mr-2" />
              <span className="text-sm tracking-[0.25em]">BACK</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <X className="w-[18px] h-[18px]" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Layer 0 - Main Menu */}
      <div className={`absolute inset-0 top-[88px] transform transition-transform duration-300 ${
        activeLayer0 ? '-translate-x-full' : 'translate-x-0'
      }`}>

      {/* Layer 1 - Category Menu */}
```

```typescript:frontend/types/placeholders.ts
export const getPlaceholderImage = (type: string, index: number = 0, category?: string, subcategory?: string) => {
  if (type === 'brand') {
    return placeholderImages.brand.variants[index % 4] || placeholderImages.brand.default
  }
  
  if (type === 'designer') {
    return placeholderImages.designer.variants[index % 4] || placeholderImages.designer.default
  }

  if (type === 'product') {
    if (!category || !subcategory) {
      return placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
    }

    // Normalize gender and section names
    const gender = category.toLowerCase().endsWith('s') ? category.toLowerCase() : `${category.toLowerCase()}s`
    const section = subcategory.toLowerCase()

    // Special case for explore section
    if (category.toLowerCase() === 'explore') {
      const sections = ['mens', 'womens']
      const gender = sections[index % 2]
      return placeholderImages.product[gender].sweaters.thumbnails[index % 4]
    }

    // Handle special sections
    if (section === 'gifts') return placeholderImages.product.gifts.thumbnails[0]
    if (section === 'lookbooks') return placeholderImages.product.lookbooks.thumbnails[index % 4]

    // Map section names to their correct paths
    const sectionMap: Record<string, string> = {
      'tops': 'tops',
      'bottoms': 'bottoms',
      'outerwear': 'outerwear',
      'sweaters': 'sweaters',
      'hoodies & sweaters': 'sweaters',
      'hoodies': 'sweaters',
      'accessories': 'accessories',
      'footwear': 'footwear'
    }

    const normalizedSection = sectionMap[section]
    if (!normalizedSection) {
      console.warn(`Unknown section: ${section} (original: ${subcategory})`)
      return placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
    }

    const genderSection = placeholderImages.product[gender as 'mens' | 'womens']
    if (!genderSection) {
      console.warn(`Unknown gender: ${gender} (original: ${category})`)
      return placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
    }

    const productSection = genderSection[normalizedSection as keyof typeof genderSection]
    return productSection?.thumbnails[index % (productSection.thumbnails.length || 1)] || placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
  }

  return placeholderImages.product.mens.tops.thumbnails[0]
}
```

```typescript:frontend/app/[category]/[section]/[subsection]/page.tsx
      image: getPlaceholderImage('product', i % 4, category, subsection.toLowerCase()),
```

```typescript:frontend/components/FeaturedBrands.tsx
                <Image

                />
              </div>

              <p className="text-xs tracking-[0.15em] text-gray-500">{item.label}</p>

}
```

```typescript:frontend/types/gridItems.ts
export const toSingular = (word: string) => {
  switch (word.toLowerCase()) {

    case 'tops': return 'Top'
    case 'bottoms': return 'Bottom'
    case 'outerwear': return 'Outerwear'
    case 'hoodies & sweaters': return 'Hoodie & Sweater'
    case 'gifts': return 'Gift'
    default: return word
  }
}
```
